exposure: Surgical task-shifting programme (STP) for Associate Clinicians
outcome: Maternal and child outcomes (measured in DALYs)
cohort: The study evaluates women with an indication for C-section in Sierra Leone.
finding: The surgical task-shifting programme in Sierra Leone is considered cost-effective, being cost-saving (USD -16.77) and resulting in 2.14 DALYs averted per woman with a C-section indication due to avoidance of maternal and child deaths and reduced complications.
